reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin that requests simplified Chinese responses through a system-prompt section and exposes a related settings-sidebar item; it does not access external services or perform file operations.

summaries.zh: 通过系统提示词请求模型使用简体中文回复，并在 DSH 设置侧边栏提供中文回复项。
summaries.en: Requests that the model reply in Simplified Chinese through a system-prompt section and adds a Chinese-reply item to the DSH settings sidebar.

capabilities: injects a system-prompt instruction requesting simplified Chinese replies
adds a Chinese-reply item to the DSH settings sidebar
supports disabling the prompt injection through configuration
